cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Mum's coming for lunch. Is this spoon clean enough for her? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. She checks cutlery. Could you check the forks while I finish this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told her to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a guest towel. Can you help me choose one without a faded stripe?

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 forks and A5 towel divert from B2 neglected kitchen; authority is mostly pasted into A3 rather than enacted through accommodation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 dirty kitchen causes A3 narrower cutlery task; B4 gloves help causes A5 towel choice.

relationship.evidence: B2 identifies the real responsibility and B4 recruits actual help; A sidesteps both.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns incoming help for the kitchen into a new hospitality detail.

specificity.evidence: A1 Mum lunch and B2 kitchen neglect establish the avoided work.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 charge phrase is an extraneous insertion into the evasion.
